summary: Frontend-only regression + Courses crash-fix verification for CyberHead Academy. All primary Courses.jsx fixes verified: /courses loads with 8 seeded course cards, category and difficulty filters work, error state renders on forced 500 (courses-error + Retry button), and empty state renders when API returns a non-array shape (courses-empty). NO 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading filter)' error observed in any data state. Search page, Home, Login (admin), navbar links (Courses, Security Lab, WAF Demo, API Docs), and /docs route all load without JS crashes. Note: Preview URL runs the dev server (yarn start), so index.html branding still shows Emergent overlay injections (title 'Emergent | Fullstack App', description 'A product of emergent.sh', ap.emergent.sh/array.js, /__emergent_overlay__/recorder.js). This is expected per the request note that overlays are dev-only. The built /app/frontend/build/index.html correctly contains 'CyberHead Academy | Learn Cybersecurity. Build. Break. Defend.' and the CyberHead description — production build is clean.

console_warnings.warning: React duplicate-key warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' with value '/api/user/profile'
console_warnings.context: Fires after admin login (admin dashboard/sidebar). Not caused by Courses fix. Likely a sidebar/nav array that repeats a key derived from an API path. Minor, non-blocking.

verified_flows: /courses difficulty filter (Beginner) -> filtered grid, no crash
/courses with mocked 500 -> courses-error shown with Retry button, no crash
/courses with non-array API shape ({unexpected:'shape'}) -> courses-empty shown, no crash
Navbar links present: Courses, Security Lab, WAF Demo, API Docs

branding_check.public_index_html: correct (CyberHead Academy title + description, favicon.svg, no posthog/emergent scripts)
branding_check.preview_served_html: still shows 'Emergent | Fullstack App' title, 'A product of emergent.sh' description, and injects ap.emergent.sh/array.js + /__emergent_overlay__/recorder.js because supervisor runs 'yarn start' (dev) not the production build. Per review request note, dev-only overlays are expected on preview — flagged for awareness only, not a regression.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate duplicate React key '/api/user/profile' in admin dashboard (post-login) — non-blocking.
INFO: If branding must appear on the preview URL, serve production build (serve -s build) via supervisor instead of 'yarn start'. Production deployment is unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: Courses.jsx correctly guards setCourses with Array.isArray(data?.courses) and guards filtered with Array.isArray(courses). All render branches (loading/error/empty/no-match/grid) have data-testid. Fix is solid.

Consider distinguishing empty-array response from non-array response: currently both fall through to courses-empty, which is fine UX but could log a warning to aid debugging if backend contract regresses.
